questions.prompt: Do you have a large extended family?
questions.sampleA1: Yes. I have family. Big family. Many people.
questions.sampleA2: Yes, I have a big family. Many uncles and aunts. And cousins. We see each other sometimes, but not often. It's nice.
questions.sampleB1: Yes, I do have quite a large extended family. We all live in different cities, so it's difficult to see everyone regularly. However, we try to get together for big holidays like Christmas or Thanksgiving. I think it's important to stay connected with family, even if it's just through phone calls or emails.
questions.sampleB2: To be honest, yes, I come from a fairly big family. I've got loads of cousins, aunts and uncles scattered all over the country. We don't see each other every day, but we always get together for the big celebrations, and I suppose that's when we really catch up. Honestly, I wouldn't have it any other way.
questions.uzSampleA1: Ha. Mening oilam bor. Katta oila. Ko'p odamlar.
questions.uzSampleA2: Ha, mening katta oilam bor. Ko'p amakilar va xolalar. Va amakivachchalar. Biz ba'zida bir-birimizni ko'ramiz, lekin tez-tez emas. Yaxshi.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Ha, menda ancha katta kengaytirilgan oila bor. Biz hammamiz turli shaharlarda yashaymiz, shuning uchun hamma bilan muntazam uchrashish qiyin.
Shunga qaramay, biz Rojdestvo yoki Minnatdorchilik kuni kabi katta bayramlarda birga yig'ilishga harakat qilamiz. Menimcha, oila bilan aloqada bo'lish muhim, hatto bu faqat telefon qo'ng'iroqlari yoki elektron pochta orqali bo'lsa ham.
questions.uzSampleB2: Ha, men ancha katta keng oiladan kelganman deb ayta olaman. Garchi biz hammamiz bir hududda yashamasak ham, biz hali ham yaqin aloqalarni saqlab qolamiz. Biz muhim oilaviy tadbirlarda qatnashishga harakat qilamiz va ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda doimo faollik kuzatiladi. Katta oilaga ega bo'lishning o'zining yaxshi va yomon tomonlari bor, albatta, lekin umuman olganda, men u ta'minlaydigan aloqa va qo'llab-quvvatlash tuyg'usini qadrlayman. Sizga g'amxo'rlik qiladigan ko'p odamlar borligini bilish taskin beradi.

vocabulary.title: Q1 - Do you have a large extended family?...

"From my perspective, having a large extended family is truly a blessing, providing a robust support system." - "Mening nuqtai nazarimdan, katta oilaga ega bo'lish haqiqatan ham baxt, bu mustahkam qo'llab-quvvatlash tizimini ta'minlaydi."

questions.sampleAnswer:
Yes, I certainly do. My family is incredibly large, with relatives scattered all over the place. In my culture, family ties are strongly cherished, and as such, we make it a point to have family reunions regularly. These gatherings provide a wonderful opportunity to catch up with everyone, and they're always full of laughter and shared stories.

Having a large extended family means that there is always someone to lend a helping hand or offer advice when needed. For instance, I grew up with numerous cousins around my age, which was immensely beneficial during my formative years. We would often hang out together, and those experiences shaped who I am today.

Moreover, "blood is thicker than water", as they say, and this rings true for my family. The sense of belonging and unconditional support that comes with having a large extended family is something I wouldn't trade for the world. It's a priceless treasure that adds depth and richness to my life.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Ha, albatta. Mening oilam juda katta, qarindoshlar hamma yoqda tarqalgan. Mening madaniyatimda oilaviy rishtalar juda qadrlanadi va shuning uchun biz muntazam ravishda oilaviy uchrashuvlar o'tkazishga harakat qilamiz. Bu yig'ilishlar hamma bilan ko'rishish uchun ajoyib imkoniyat yaratadi va ular doimo kulgi va umumiy hikoyalarga to'la bo'ladi.

Katta oilaga ega bo'lish, kerak bo'lganda yordam beradigan yoki maslahat beradigan doim kimdir borligini anglatadi. Misol uchun, men tengdoshlarim bilan o'sdim, bu mening shakllanish yillarimda juda foydali bo'ldi. Biz ko'pincha birga vaqt o'tkazardik va bu tajribalar bugungi kimligimni shakllantirdi.

Qolaversa, "qon suvdan quyuqroq", deyishadi, va bu mening oilam uchun ham to'g'ri. Katta oilaga ega bo'lish bilan birga keladigan mansublik hissi va shartsiz qo'llab-quvvatlash men hech narsaga alishmaydigan narsadir. Bu mening hayotimga chuqurlik va boylik qo'shadigan bebaho xazina.

questions.prompt: Do you have a lot of friends?
questions.sampleA1: Yes. I have friends. Two friends. They are good.
questions.sampleA2: Yes, I have some friends. I like to play with them. We play football and we eat pizza. My friends are nice, but sometimes we argue.
questions.sampleB1: Well, I think I have a few good friends. I don't have a lot, but the ones I have are important to me. We like to go to the cinema or just hang out. I think it's better to have a few close friends than many that you don't really know. For example, I have known my best friend since I was a child.
questions.sampleB2: I wouldn't say I have loads of friends, but the ones I do have are worth their weight in gold. The thing is, I've always valued quality over quantity when it comes to friendships. I've got a tight-knit group of about four or five people I can really count on, and honestly, that suits me down to the ground.
questions.uzSampleA1: Ha. Mening do'stlarim bor. Ikki do'stim. Ular yaxshi.
questions.uzSampleA2: Ha, mening bir nechta do'stlarim bor. Men ular bilan o'ynashni yaxshi ko'raman. Biz futbol o'ynaymiz va pizza yeymiz. Mening do'stlarim yaxshi, lekin ba'zida biz tortishamiz.
questions.uzSampleB1: Xo'sh, menimcha, menda bir nechta yaxshi do'stlar bor. Menda ko'p emas, lekin borlari men uchun muhim. Biz kinoga borishni yoki shunchaki birga vaqt o'tkazishni yoqtiramiz. Menimcha, yaxshi tanimaydigan ko'p do'stlarga qaraganda, bir nechta yaqin do'stlarning bo'lishi yaxshiroq. Misol uchun, men eng yaqin do'stimni bolaligimdan beri bilaman.
questions.uzSampleB2: Men juda ko'p do'stlarim bor deb ayta olmayman, lekin men yaqin bo'lgan mustahkam bir guruh odamlarim bor. Do'stlikka kelganda, men sifatni miqdordan ustun qo'yaman. Meni tushunadigan va qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan odamlar bilan chinakam aloqalarga ega bo'lish men uchun muhimroq. Yangi odamlar bilan tanishish menga yoqsa-da, men allaqachon mavjud bo'lgan munosabatlarni rivojlantirishga ustunlik beraman. Men kuchli do'stliklar to'laqonli hayot uchun zarur deb hisoblayman va mening hayotimda haqiqatan ham ajoyib odamlar borligidan baxtiyorman.

questions.sampleAnswer: Honestly, I would say that I have a close-knit group of friends rather than a large number of acquaintances. I cherish the time spent with my inner circle, as we have built strong bonds over the years. It's not about the quantity but the quality of friendships. My friends and I look out for each other, and we always have each other's backs, which I think is incredibly important. In today's digital age, it's easy to amass a vast number of online connections; however, I genuinely believe in the value of face-to-face interactions and shared experiences. As the saying goes, "A friend in need is a friend indeed." So, while my circle may not be vast, it's certainly filled with people who matter the most to me.
questions.uzSampleAnswer: Rostini aytsam, men ko'p tanishlarim bo'lishidan ko'ra, juda yaqin do'stlar davrasiga egaman, deb aytgan bo'lardim. Yillar davomida mustahkam aloqalar o'rnatganligimiz sababli, men o'zimning yaqin do'stlarim bilan o'tkazgan vaqtimni qadrlayman. Gap do'stlar sonida emas, balki ularning sifatidadir. Do'stlarim bilan bir-birimizga g'amxo'rlik qilamiz va doimo bir-birimizni qo'llab-quvvatlaymiz, bu esa menimcha juda muhim. Bugungi raqamli davrda ko'plab onlayn aloqalarni to'plash oson; ammo, men yuzma-yuz muloqot va birgalikda o'tkazilgan tajribalarning qadriga chin dildan ishonaman. Maqolda aytilganidek, "Do'st dardingga sherik bo'lganda bilinadi". Shunday ekan, do'stlarim soni ko'p bo'lmasligi mumkin, lekin ular, albatta, men uchun eng muhim bo'lgan insonlarga to'la.

questions.sampleAnswer:
When it comes to cooking, I genuinely enjoy experimenting with a wide array of dishes, but I have a particular fondness for Italian cuisine. I picked up the art of making homemade pasta from my grandmother, and it has become second nature to me. There’s nothing quite like the texture and flavor of freshly rolled pasta. Additionally, I often whip up a variety of sauces ranging from a simple tomato basil to a more sophisticated Alfredo. "Variety is the spice of life," and I believe that trying different cuisines enhances one's culinary skills.

Aside from Italian dishes, I dabble in Asian cuisine as well. I find stir-frying vegetables with a dash of soy sauce and a sprinkle of sesame seeds a piece of cake. It's absolutely satisfying to create something healthy and delicious in such a short amount of time. Moreover, I often try out new recipes from various cultures, as I believe cooking is not just about sustenance but also a social experience that brings people together.

In conclusion, while I have my go-to dishes, I am constantly eager to expand my repertoire and broaden my horizons by trying out new cuisines. Cooking for me is not just a chore, but an art form that allows me to let my creativity flow.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Ovqat tayyorlashga kelganda, men turli xil taomlar bilan tajriba o'tkazishni chin dildan yoqtiraman, lekin italyan oshxonasiga alohida mehrim bor. Uyda makaron tayyorlash san'atini buvimdan o'rganganman va bu men uchun odatiy holga aylanib qoldi. Yangi yoyilgan makaronning tuzilishi va ta'mi bilan hech narsa tenglasha olmaydi. Bundan tashqari, men ko'pincha oddiy pomidor rayhonidan tortib, yanada murakkab Alfredo sousigacha bo'lgan turli xil souslarni tezda tayyorlayman. "Xilma-xillik hayotning ziravoridir" va menimcha, turli xil oshxonalarni sinab ko'rish odamning pazandalik mahoratini oshiradi.

Italyan taomlaridan tashqari, men Osiyo oshxonasida ham ozgina tajriba o'tkazaman. Sabzavotlarni soya sousi va kunjut urug'lari bilan qovurish men uchun juda oson. Bunday qisqa vaqt ichida sog'lom va mazali narsa yaratish juda yoqimli. Bundan tashqari, men ko'pincha turli madaniyatlardan yangi retseptlarni sinab ko'raman, chunki menimcha, ovqat tayyorlash nafaqat oziq-ovqat bilan ta'minlash, balki odamlarni birlashtiradigan ijtimoiy tajribadir.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, mening doimiy tayyorlaydigan taomlarim bo'lsa-da, men doimo o'z mahoratimni oshirishga va yangi oshxonalarni sinab ko'rish orqali ufqlarimni kengaytirishga intilaman. Ovqat tayyorlash men uchun shunchaki majburiyat emas, balki ijod qilish imkonini beradigan san'at turidir.

She appears focused and engaged in this remote learning setup. In contrast, the second picture depicts a vibrant traditional classroom with several children. The main difference is the learning format: one shows digital education, the other the dynamic atmosphere of a physical school.

questions.sampleAnswer:
Starting with the first image, what really stands out is the virtual classroom setting, which highlights the new wave of education. The young girl, keenly focused, appears genuinely absorbed in her online session. Her use of blue headphones likely helps tune out distractions, enhancing her concentration. It's clear as day that she's an active participant, as evidenced by her note-taking. This setting perfectly illustrates the shift towards digital learning environments. The calm and neutral backdrop of her home, with its soft tones, creates a conducive atmosphere for study, making her approach to learning not only effective but also quite appealing.

In contrast, the second image presents a more traditional yet dynamic classroom atmosphere. The vibrancy here is truly palpable. The children, seated at their desks, are all ears, with their expressions and body language speaking volumes about their engagement. The girl in the bright pink sweater, in particular, exemplifies learning with a smile, suggesting an enjoyable educational experience. The light green walls and the warmth from natural sunlight not only add to the overall ambiance but also reflect an environment where students can soak up knowledge effortlessly. As the saying goes, "A picture is worth a thousand words," and this image, in all its detail, effectively captures the essence of a positive and engaging learning space.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Birinchi rasmga nazar tashlasak, ko‘zga tashlanadigan eng asosiy narsa – bu virtual sinf muhiti bo‘lib, u ta’limdagi yangi to‘lqinni namoyon etadi. Yosh qizaloqning diqqati jamlangan holda onlayn darsiga berilib ketgani yaqqol ko‘rinib turibdi. Uning ko‘k rangli naushniklardan foydalanishi, ehtimol, chalg‘ituvchi omillarni bartaraf etishga yordam berib, diqqatini kuchaytiradi. Uning darsga faol ishtirok etayotgani kundalik tutayotganidan ham bilinib turibdi. Bu muhit raqamli ta’lim muhitiga o‘tishni mukammal tarzda aks ettiradi. Uning uyidagi xotirjam va neytral fon, yumshoq ranglari bilan birga, o‘qish uchun qulay muhit yaratadi, bu esa uning ta’limga yondashuvini nafaqat samarali, balki juda yoqimli qiladi.

Bunga zid ravishda, ikkinchi rasm an’anaviy, ammo dinamik sinf muhitini taqdim etadi. Bu yerdagi hayotiylik juda sezilarli. O‘quvchilar partalarida o‘tirgan holda, diqqat bilan tinglashmoqda, ularning ifodalari va tana tili ularning qanchalik jalb qilinganini yaqqol ko‘rsatib turibdi. Ayniqsa, yorqin pushti sviter kiygan qizaloq tabassum bilan o‘rganishga misol bo‘la oladi, bu esa zavqli ta’lim tajribasidan dalolat beradi. Och yashil devorlar va tabiiy quyosh nuridan kelayotgan iliqlik nafaqat umumiy muhitga qo‘shimcha joziba bag‘ishlaydi, balki o‘quvchilar bilim olishi mumkin bo‘lgan muhitni aks ettiradi. Aytishlaricha, "Bir rasm ming so‘zga arziydi", va bu rasm o‘zining barcha tafsilotlari bilan ijobiy va qiziqarli o‘quv makonining mohiyatini samarali tarzda aks ettiradi.

questions.sampleA2: I like online study. It is good because I can stay home. And I can study when I want. But class is good too because I can see my friends.

The thing is, you can study from the comfort of your own home and learn at your own pace, without the daily commute. That said, I do think a traditional classroom has its perks — the face-to-face interaction keeps you on track. But on the whole, I lean towards online.

questions.sampleAnswer:
Honestly, the question of whether studying online or in a traditional classroom is more comfortable really depends on individual preferences and circumstances. Personally, I feel that studying online offers an unparalleled level of convenience and flexibility. You can log in from anywhere, whether you’re at home or on the go, which makes it easier to balance other commitments like work or family.

However, I must admit that traditional classrooms provide a social experience that is incredibly valuable. The interactions with classmates and teachers can foster a deeper understanding of the material and create a sense of community. "Different strokes for different folks," as the saying goes. While some thrive in a face-to-face setting, others excel in the online arena.

Moreover, in today’s digital age, online education has come a long way with interactive content and virtual classrooms that mimic the traditional setting. Personally, I have taken advantage of online courses to advance my skills and make progress without having to put my life on hold. So, to sum up, while traditional classrooms have their own undeniable benefits, the comfort and flexibility of online learning make it exceptionally appealing for me.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Rostini aytsam, onlayn o'qish qulayroqmi yoki an'anaviy sinf xonasidami degan savol, aslida, har bir insonning shaxsiy xohishlari va vaziyatlariga bog'liq. Shaxsan men, onlayn o'qish misli ko'rilmagan darajadagi qulaylik va moslashuvchanlikni taqdim etadi deb hisoblayman. Siz istalgan joydan tizimga kirishingiz mumkin, xoh u uyda bo'ling, xoh yo'lda, bu esa ish yoki oila kabi boshqa majburiyatlarni muvozanatlashni osonlashtiradi.

Biroq, tan olishim kerakki, an'anaviy sinf xonalari nihoyatda qimmatli bo'lgan ijtimoiy tajribani taqdim etadi. Sinfdoshlar va o'qituvchilar bilan bo'ladigan muloqotlar materialni chuqurroq tushunishga yordam beradi va hamjamiyat tuyg'usini yaratadi. "Har kimning o'z yo'li bor", deganlaridek. Ba'zilar yuzma-yuz muhitda rivojlansa, boshqalar onlayn maydonda a'lo natijalarga erishadi.

Bundan tashqari, bugungi raqamli asrda onlayn ta'lim interaktiv kontent va an'anaviy muhitni taqlid qiluvchi virtual sinf xonalari bilan uzoq yo'lni bosib o'tdi. Shaxsan men, o'z hayotimni to'xtatib qo'ymasdan, ko'nikmalarimni oshirish va taraqqiyotga erishish uchun onlayn kurslardan foydalandim. Xulosa qilib aytganda, an'anaviy sinf xonalari o'zining inkor etib bo'lmaydigan afzalliklariga ega bo'lsa-da, onlayn ta'limning qulayligi va moslashuvchanligi uni men uchun juda jozibali qiladi.

questions.sampleAnswer:
In my opinion, the biggest challenges of online learning undoubtedly revolve around the lack of interaction and engagement that students experience compared to traditional classroom settings. One of the most significant hurdles is the absence of a social experience which adds spice to the learning process. In a physical classroom, students have the opportunity to bounce ideas off each other and engage in stimulating discussions, which immensely enriches their understanding of the subject matter. Unfortunately, this is something technology, despite its advancements, hasn't cracked the code for yet.

Additionally, managing time effectively is another stumbling block for many students. When studying online, it's incredibly easy to get sidetracked by distractions at home, be it social media or household chores. Without the structure of a traditional school day, some students find it hard to stay focused and motivated. A personal example is when I took up an online course during summer; I often found myself procrastinating, which made it extremely challenging to meet deadlines.

Moreover, the digital divide is a glaring issue. Not all students have access to reliable internet or necessary devices, which levels the playing field for those in less fortunate circumstances. This disparity can deepen educational inequalities, thus making online learning problematic for some.

In essence, while online learning offers unparalleled flexibility and a wealth of resources, it comes with its own set of challenges that need to be addressed for it to be truly effective. As someone once wisely said, "Where there is a will, there is a way", and with the right strategies and tools, these challenges can be surmounted.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Menimcha, onlayn ta’limning eng katta muammolari, shubhasiz, talabalarning an’anaviy sinf muhitiga nisbatan o‘zaro aloqa va ishtirok etish darajasining yetishmasligi bilan bog‘liq. Eng muhim to‘siqlardan biri bu o‘quv jarayoniga o‘zgachalik qo‘shadigan ijtimoiy tajribaning yo‘qligidir. An’anaviy sinfda talabalar bir-birlari bilan fikr almashish va mavzuni chuqurroq tushunishga yordam beradigan qiziqarli muhokamalarda ishtirok etish imkoniyatiga ega. Afsuski, texnologiya, qanchalik rivojlangan bo‘lmasin, hali bu muammoni hal qila olgani yo‘q.

Bundan tashqari, vaqtni samarali boshqarish ko‘plab talabalar uchun yana bir to‘siqdir. Onlayn o‘qish jarayonida uyda ijtimoiy tarmoqlar yoki uy yumushlari kabi chalg‘ituvchi omillarga chalg‘ish juda oson. An’anaviy maktab kunining tuzilmasisiz, ba’zi talabalar diqqatini jamlash va motivatsiyani saqlab qolishda qiynaladi. Shaxsiy misol sifatida, yozda onlayn kursga yozilganimda, ko‘pincha vaqtni cho‘zib yurardim, bu esa topshiriqlarni o‘z vaqtida topshirishni juda qiyinlashtirardi.

Qolaversa, raqamli tafovut yaqqol ko‘zga tashlanadigan muammodir. Hamma talabalarning ham ishonchli internetga yoki zarur qurilmalarga kirish imkoniyati yo‘q, bu esa imkoniyati cheklanganlar uchun tengsizlikni keltirib chiqaradi. Bu nomutanosiblik ta’limdagi tengsizlikni yanada kuchaytirishi mumkin, shuning uchun onlayn ta’lim ba’zilar uchun muammoli bo‘lib qolmoqda.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, onlayn ta’lim misli ko‘rilmagan moslashuvchanlik va ko‘plab resurslarni taklif qilsa-da, u o‘ziga xos muammolar bilan birga keladi, ularni haqiqatan ham samarali bo‘lishi uchun hal qilish kerak. Bir donishmand aytganidek, "Niyat bo‘lsa, yo‘l topiladi", to‘g‘ri strategiyalar va vositalar bilan bu muammolarni yengish mumkin.

questions.sampleB2: Okay, so a moment when I felt genuinely happy that springs to mind was the day I got my university acceptance letter. I remember it like it was yesterday — I'd been on tenterhooks for weeks, checking my email every five minutes. When I finally saw the word 'congratulations', I honestly felt like I was walking on air. My whole family gathered round, and we celebrated late into the night. There were tears of joy, hugs all round, and my mum even baked my favourite cake to mark the occasion. To this day, it stands out as one of the proudest moments of my life. As for what contributes most to my own happiness, I'd have to say it's the people around me. The thing is, no achievement really means much unless you've got someone to share it with. Spending quality time with family and close friends is what truly lifts my spirits. On top of that, having a sense of purpose — working towards something I truly care about — keeps me grounded and content. When it comes to society as a whole, I suppose there are several factors at play. Financial security is a big one, because it's hard to be happy when you're struggling to make ends meet. Good health matters just as much — at the end of the day, your wellbeing underpins everything else. And I'd argue that strong relationships and a supportive community go a long way too. So, all things considered, happiness isn't really about money or status; it's more about connection, health and feeling that your life has meaning.

bulletPoints: Describe a moment in your life when you felt genuinely happy.
What do you think contributes the most to your happiness?
In your opinion, what are the main factors that influence people's happiness in society?
questions.sampleAnswer:
One of the moments in my life when I felt genuinely happy was when I picked up my first puppy from the animal shelter. The moment I stepped into the shelter and saw those innocent eyes looking at me, I knew I had made the right decision. The joy I felt was incredibly profound; it was as if all my worries and stresses just melted away. I believe this happiness was due to the combination of having a new companion and the fulfillment of giving a homeless animal a loving home.

As for what contributes the most to my happiness, I would say it's the social experience of being surrounded by supportive friends and family. This network of loved ones provides me with a sense of belonging and a foundation of trust that is absolutely crucial for my well-being. "No man is an island," and I honestly believe that the people we choose to hang out with play a significant role in our overall happiness.

In my opinion, the main factors that influence people's happiness in society include financial stability, meaningful relationships, and a sense of purpose. While money can't buy happiness, financial stability can take away a lot of stress related to basic needs, allowing individuals to pursue passions and hobbies that bring joy. Additionally, strong, supportive relationships and a purpose in life—be it through a career, volunteering, or personal projects—are indispensable in creating long-term happiness. "Happiness is not something ready-made. It comes from your own actions," and understanding this helps people figure out what truly matters in life.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Hayotimdagi chinakam baxtni his qilgan lahzalardan biri, hayvonlar boshpanasidan birinchi kuchugimni olganimda bo'lgan edi. Boshpanaga qadam qo'yganim va menga begunoh ko'zlar bilan boqqanini ko'rganim zahoti, to'g'ri qaror qabul qilganimni angladim. His qilgan quvonchim juda chuqur edi; go'yo barcha tashvishlarim va stresslarim shundoq yo'q bo'lib ketgandek bo'ldi. Menimcha, bu baxt yangi hamrohga ega bo'lish va uysiz hayvonga mehribon uy berishning qoniqishidan kelib chiqqan.

Mening baxtimga eng ko'p hissa qo'shadigan narsaga kelsak, bu meni qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan do'stlar va oila qurshovida bo'lishning ijtimoiy tajribasi deb aytgan bo'lardim. Bu yaqinlar tarmog'i menga mansublik hissini va farovonligim uchun mutlaqo muhim bo'lgan ishonch asosini ta'minlaydi. "Hech kim orol emas" va men rostini aytsam, biz vaqt o'tkazishni tanlagan odamlar umumiy baxtimizda muhim rol o'ynaydi deb hisoblayman.

Mening fikrimcha, jamiyatda odamlarning baxtiga ta'sir qiluvchi asosiy omillar moliyaviy barqarorlik, mazmunli munosabatlar va maqsad hissi. Pul baxtni sotib ololmasa-da, moliyaviy barqarorlik asosiy ehtiyojlar bilan bog'liq ko'plab stressni olib tashlashi mumkin, bu esa odamlarga quvonch keltiradigan ishtiyoq va hobbilarni davom ettirishga imkon beradi. Bundan tashqari, kuchli, qo'llab-quvvatlovchi munosabatlar va hayotdagi maqsad - bu kasb, ko'ngillilik yoki shaxsiy loyihalar orqali bo'lsin - uzoq muddatli baxtni yaratishda ajralmasdir. "Baxt tayyor narsa emas. U sizning o'z harakatlaringizdan kelib chiqadi" va buni tushunish odamlarga hayotda nima muhimligini aniqlashga yordam beradi.

questions.prompt: Students should be allowed to choose their own subjects in school.
questions.sampleA1: Yes, I think good. I like art. I don't like math.
questions.sampleA2: I think students can choose. Because it is good for them. They can study what they like. And if they like it, they will learn more.
questions.sampleB1: I think it's a good idea for students to choose their subjects. If they choose, they will be more interested in learning. For example, if a student likes music, they can choose music class. However, maybe some subjects are important for everyone, like math or science.
questions.sampleB2: That's an interesting one, and honestly, I can see the argument from both sides. On the one hand, there's a strong case for letting students pick and choose their own subjects. The thing is, when young people study what genuinely interests them, they tend to be far more motivated and engaged. If a student is passionate about art or science, forcing them to sit through subjects they can't stand often puts them off learning altogether. On top of that, choosing early can help them zero in on a future career and play to their strengths. It also teaches them to take responsibility for their own decisions, which is a valuable life skill. On the other hand, I do think there's a risk in giving teenagers completely free rein. At that age, a lot of them don't really know what's good for them in the long run. Someone might drop maths or a language simply because it's hard, only to regret it down the line. A broad, balanced education gives you a solid foundation and keeps your options open, which I think is really valuable. So where do I stand? Personally, I'd go for a middle ground. I reckon schools should keep a core of essential subjects like maths and their native language compulsory, while giving students the freedom to choose a handful of electives alongside them. That way, you get the best of both worlds — young people stay motivated by following their interests, but they don't miss out on the basics. At the end of the day, it's all about striking the right balance.

questions.sampleAnswer:
Allowing students to choose their own subjects in school can genuinely foster a higher level of motivation and engagement in their learning journey. When students are given the freedom to select subjects that align with their interests and career aspirations, they are more likely to be enthusiastic about their studies. This choice cultivates a sense of responsibility over their educational path, empowering them to take ownership of their learning processes. Moreover, aligning subjects with future career goals can really provide them with a clear direction and purpose, paving the way for a successful professional life.

However, one must consider the potential downsides of such an approach. It honestly requires a certain level of maturity and knowledge for students to choose wisely. Young learners might lack the foresight to understand the importance of maintaining a balanced curriculum, which is crucial for a well-rounded education. There is also the risk that students might end up neglecting essential subjects, which could come back to haunt them later in life. As the saying goes, "Don't put all your eggs in one basket," highlighting the importance of diversification in education.

In my opinion, a hybrid model could be the most effective approach. Schools could offer a core curriculum that ensures essential subjects are covered while allowing students to choose electives that resonate with their interests. This balance could help students develop both a strong educational foundation and the freedom to explore their passions, thereby killing two birds with one stone – ensuring a well-rounded education while enabling personal growth and future career alignment.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
O'quvchilarga maktabda o'z fanlarini tanlashga ruxsat berish, ularning o'quv jarayonida yuqori darajadagi motivatsiya va ishtiyoqni chin dildan oshirishi mumkin. O'quvchilarga o'z qiziqishlari va kasbiy intilishlariga mos keladigan fanlarni tanlash erkinligi berilganda, ular o'qishga ko'proq ishtiyoq bilan yondashadilar. Bu tanlov ularning ta'lim yo'lidagi mas'uliyat hissini rivojlantiradi va ularga o'z o'quv jarayonlarini boshqarish imkoniyatini beradi. Bundan tashqari, fanlarni kelajakdagi kasbiy maqsadlar bilan moslashtirish, ularga aniq yo'nalish va maqsadni ta'minlashi, muvaffaqiyatli professional hayotga yo'l ochishi mumkin.

Biroq, bunday yondashuvning potentsial kamchiliklarini ham hisobga olish kerak. Bu, rostini aytsam, o'quvchilarning oqilona tanlov qilishlari uchun ma'lum darajadagi yetuklik va bilimni talab qiladi. Yosh o'quvchilar har tomonlama ta'lim uchun juda muhim bo'lgan muvozanatli o'quv dasturini saqlash muhimligini tushunish uchun yetarli darajada uzoqni ko'ra olmasligi mumkin. Shuningdek, o'quvchilar muhim fanlarga e'tibor bermaslik xavfi ham mavjud, bu esa keyinchalik ularga pand berishi mumkin. Aytganlaridek, "Barcha tuxumlarni bir savatga solma", bu ta'limda diversifikatsiyaning muhimligini ta'kidlaydi.

Mening fikrimcha, gibrid model eng samarali yondashuv bo'lishi mumkin. Maktablar muhim fanlar qamrab olinishini ta'minlaydigan asosiy o'quv dasturini taklif qilishi va shu bilan birga o'quvchilarga o'z qiziqishlariga mos keladigan fanlarni tanlashga ruxsat berishi mumkin. Bu muvozanat o'quvchilarga ham kuchli ta'lim asosini rivojlantirishga, ham o'z ishtiyoqlarini o'rganish erkinligini ta'minlashga yordam berishi mumkin, shu bilan birga bir o'q bilan ikki quyonni urish - har tomonlama ta'limni ta'minlash bilan birga shaxsiy o'sish va kelajakdagi kasbiy moslashuvni ta'minlash.
